card.title: How Much Do You Know?
card.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What did the manager say about the missing keys?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They might be in the drain. You locked up, didn't you?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is she asking everyone who locked up, or just me?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just you. Someone saw you outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did they say what I was doing, or only where I was?

mechanism: A tests the reach of a missing-key inquiry while withholding whether and how they locked up.
confusable: Unlike seeking neutral information, A must redirect personal questions toward what the questioner already knows.
comparison: D06-b narrows eyewitness knowledge; D06-a narrows hearsay and video exposure.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
